IIb_universe: PubChem-absent candidates (same cache/procedure as loo_mean_profile ranks / visualize_novel_molecules_grid.py)
baseline_distance_source: recomputed Euclidean vs PAPER_HARDCODED_MEANS on all 15 descriptors, using min-max scales from the full unfiltered pool CSV; reproduces historical CSV RefrigerantDistance (Tables S2-S5) to >=6 significant figures
experiment: Leave-one-descriptor-out: drop one of the fixed 15 descriptors; re-rank with remaining 14 vs full 15-D baseline. Both use the paper's hardcoded mean profile (PAPER_HARDCODED_MEANS) and min-max scales taken from the full, unfiltered all_molecules_ranked.csv per strategy — i.e. exactly reproducing the historical screening pipeline (find_refrigerant_candidates.py), not the mean dynamically recomputed from the 21 profile fluids.
fold_distance_source: recomputed Euclidean vs PAPER_HARDCODED_MEANS on the 14 kept descriptors, same scale convention
metrics: Spearman ρ among baseline top-100 rows
scale_mode: min–max on the full, unfiltered all_molecules_ranked.csv per strategy (paper-consistent; active descriptors only)
